title: Station state post with the boot id and the wall steps
description: Designed (docs/native/capture-split.md 4.3 "Clocks", 4.5, 11 H1d, #773), not implemented. Today's body of POST /api/station/state (station-state.schema.json, through the `allOf`). Since #795 the station already sends both keys this design needs: `boot_id`, the boot id the post was made under (the design calls it `boot`; on the state post it is the as-built `boot_id`, and the app sends that key, from its status file's `boot`), and `wall_steps`, the wall steps counted since that boot. Their types and rules are station-state's; this adds only the 2^53 - 1 bound on `wall_steps`. With both on every post, each `hub.skew` sample carries them, and the hub may place a call's start by the skew only with samples of the call's own boot that bracket its start with no wall step since (a reboot always counts as one). The default, until the hub reads them (it reads neither yet): the skew path is unavailable, and a flagged call the hub cannot place by its boot age alarms with the label "emergency still set after All clear". Both keys are optional, so every post a station sends today is valid here.

wall_steps.description: The wall steps counted since boot `boot_id` (a change of wall - boot clock by more than 5 s between samples at most 5 s apart), a count. It only rises within one boot; a new `boot_id` starts it again. Its type (an integer) and its minimum (0) are station-state's, which has carried `wall_steps` as built since #795; this adds only the 2^53 - 1 bound, so a wrong value breaks one rule, not the same rule twice.
